1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Nadolol  
Diagnosis 
PA required for patients 18 years of age or older  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to 3 of the following:  
• 
atenolol  
• 
atenolol/chlorthalidone  
• 
bisoprolol fumarate
